about: Ready-made rights for a new login, picked at the top of the User Management form (store's request of 17 Oct 2026: "template bana de" — one pick of a type and all its rights fall into place). The store approved the six types and their screens on 17 Oct 2026; the Kiosk device type went the same day with the kiosk itself ("management k according manual detail fill karke issuance karna time waste h"), leaving five. A sixth, the read-only Part Search Kiosk for the kiosk outside the store, joined on 25 Oct 2026. Each right was checked against the screens the person uses and the endpoints those screens call; `why` says which. This one file is read by the User Management screen (lib/roleTemplates.js) and by the backend test (backend/tests/test_role_templates.py), which signs in as each template and calls those endpoints. Keys are backend/app/models/user.py PERMISSION_MODULES. Rights are CRUD since 24 Oct 2026 (view = read only, create = add new, update = change, delete = remove / cancel); any write carries view, and only the actions a screen has (MODULE_ACTIONS) are ever true. Each old edit became every write its screen has, so a template does what it did before.

templates.label: Store Staff
templates.description: Issue, return and receive on Scan Part, stock count, put-away, reports.

why.rejection_request: Rejection Mail: the mail to RQC to punch an SRV / line rejection, as an Outlook draft (POST /rejection-requests, GET /:id/mail) — added 22 Oct 2026
why.short_mail: Short Mail: the mail to Purchase for material received short against an invoice, as an Outlook draft (POST /short-mail/draft) — added 25 Oct 2026
why.scan_part: Scan Part (issue / return / move / part QR label) (POST /spare-stock/parts/:id/issue, /issues/:id/return, /barcode/print); the Work Queue's actions
why.action_tracker: Action Tracker (GET /dashboard/spare/management) — its own right since 23 Oct 2026, like the seven below
why.notifications: Notification Center: the store's live alerts, read only (GET /spare-alerts)
why.receiving: Receiving & GRN (GET /receiving-monitor, /erp-grn/preview); posting a GRN line to stock needs an edit right
why.put_away_check: Put-away Check, on its own and as Scan Part's mode (POST /spare-stock/put-away/record)

templates.label: Store Supervisor
templates.description: Everything Store Staff does, plus Part Master, Department Emails, Scan Audit, Audit Trail, ERP vs Physical, Urgent Challan Register.

why.data_quality: Data Quality: the missing Max / Min / Rate / Location list and its quick fixes (GET /data-quality, PUT /parts/:id)
why.erp_control: ERP Control Center (GET /erp-control/status); its ERP push needs the Store Stock edit right
why.store_stock: as Store Staff (also the ERP push on ERP Control Center and the ERP stock upload on ERP vs Physical)
why.part_master: Part Master (POST / PUT /parts) with its Photo Mode (POST / DELETE /parts/:id/image), and the Line / Machine / Die master it keeps since 23 Oct 2026 (PUT /equipment/:id, POST /equipment/import)
why.supplier_barcodes: Scan Part's Barcodes panel and its unknown-code prompt: map a supplier's barcode to a part, e.g. one Scan Audit shows as unknown (POST /barcode/mapping)
why.scan_audit: Scan Audit screen, open to this right since 17 Oct 2026 (was administrators only) (GET /barcode/scan-audit)
why.employees: Employee Master edit + Excel import (PUT /employees/:id, POST /employees/import)
why.challan_register: Urgent Challan Register: enter an urgent challan, link its invoice and GRN, cancel (GET / POST /challans, /challans/:id/invoices, /grn) — added 22 Oct 2026

templates.label: Line User (Maintenance / Tool Room)
templates.description: Only Confirm Installation: fill the line / machine / die of a part issued to the floor.

why.install_confirm: Confirm Installation (POST /spare-stock/issues/:id/confirm; its Line / Machine / Die pick-lists, GET /equipment, accept this right too). Its lists GET /spare-stock/pending-confirmations, /installations and /spare-flow/parts/:id/scan-result need only the store.

templates.label: Manager
templates.description: Sees everything of the Spare Parts Store, changes nothing.

why.store_stock: Store Stock list; view only, so no count, upload or ERP push
why.put_away_check: Put-away Check, view only: no put-away is recorded
why.live_dashboard: Live Board link in the sidebar (/live-dashboard)
why.challan_register: Urgent Challan Register, read only: tiles, ageing, list, history, Excel (GET /challans, /challans/dashboard)
why.rejection_request: Rejection Mail, read only: the mails made (GET /rejection-requests)
why.short_mail: Short Mail, read only: who it goes to (GET /short-mail/settings)

templates.label: Live Board (HMI / TV)
templates.description: Only the Live Board on the HMI / TV screen.

why.live_dashboard: Live Board (GET /dashboard/spare/overview + /management accept it); its other figures (GET /spare-stock/today, /flow, /activity, /spare-flow/queues) need only the store. Without spare_store the board hides its Main Dashboard exit.

templates.label: Part Search Kiosk
templates.description: The kiosk outside the spare store: search a part and see its photo, stock, location and section. Read only — it changes nothing and stays signed in.

why.part_kiosk: Part Search kiosk (GET /part-kiosk/parts, photos from GET /parts/:id/image) — added 25 Oct 2026
